rationale.reason_1: Combinatorial complexity - generating and counting 915M+ combinations requires efficient algorithms and data structures
rationale.reason_2: State space representation - must model 3D spatial positioning and rotation of LEGO bricks accurately
rationale.reason_3: Heuristic design - creating a meaningful trivial vs complicated classification requires domain knowledge and subjective criteria definition
rationale.reason_4: Performance optimization - brute force enumeration of 915M combinations demands computational efficiency and likely memoization/pruning strategies
rationale.reason_5: Validation complexity - verifying the exact claim requires mathematical precision and handling edge cases in 3D geometry
